_: AGENT-UI-CONTROL (7 Nov 2026): the screen actions an AI employee may send to the browser of the person it helps. One list for the API (v1 operations and MCP tools: services/api/src/v1-screen.ts), the browser (apps/web/app/agent-ui/actions.ts handles each name) and the database (pulse.agent_ui_action_level decides the level; tests/core/test_agent_ui_control.py checks they agree). Levels: view < act < admin; Settings and admin screens need admin. FIX-CHAT-AI (10 Nov 2026): screen.read (the page as a short map), element.click and field.fill (visible, with the AI cursor); a click whose words delete, send, pay or approve needs admin. AGENT-OPERATOR (13 Nov 2026): file.upload (a file shared in the chat goes into a file field on the page) and file.download (a file the page links to is attached in the chat), both act; a click whose words send, pay, delete or approve needs 'confirm': asked every time, and only the person whose screen it is says yes.

levels.label: View
levels.says: It shows you things: opens pages and files beside the chat, opens or closes the sidebar, opens tabs, points at buttons and reads what is on your screen.

levels.label: Act
levels.says: It also does things on your screen: clicks buttons, fills in fields, types in the message box, adds emoji, opens forms, asks you for a file and starts the microphone. It can also add a file to a page and download a file into the chat. A click that sends, pays, deletes or approves always asks you first, every time.

levels.label: Admin
levels.says: It also opens Settings and admin screens, and forms that add people.

actions.name: file.upload
actions.asks: add a file to the page
actions.did: Added a file to the page
